# Citations in Markdown

A first claim [@roe2020], and one by name: @doe2024 showed it first. A
grouped citation [see @poe2022, pp. 101-110; @roe2020] keeps one bracket,
and the year stands alone where the author is named already: Roe
[-@roe2020] wrote it down.

An in-text citation takes a locator, @doe2024 [p. 46], and a second
citation of one work adds no entry [@doe2024, chap. 2]. An unknown key
[@ghost] shows its mark, while an e-mail address such as
someone@example.org, a code span `@roe2020` and an escaped \@roe2020 stay
text.
